programme.desc: This week on Around the ACL, Trey, Jake, and Meesh dive into the latest pro shakeups with new partnerships announced—including Devon Harbaugh teaming up with AJ Sims, Matt Wilson with Sarah Cassidy, and more. Then, we break down the full 25/26 ACL schedule and go inside the updated season format, with memberships now live. - We also bring the heat with our ATA Gametime segment: 4Bagger & Floor Bagger (top and low moments of the week), Send It or Board It (would we go for it?), and a round of Would You Rather. The crew closes out with bold predictions in our “Hole-y Hot Take” finale.
